applies_to.description: The rows the field applies to.

code.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `invalid_request` or `not_found`.

details.description: One entry per rejected field. Empty when the error is not about a field.

field.description: The field that was rejected, such as `portal.enabled`.

code.description: Why it was rejected, such as `unknown_field`, `invalid_boolean`, `constraint_violation` or `required`.

value.description: The value you sent, when the API includes it.

order_flags.description: The store's order flags. Read-only here: manage them through `/api/v4/admin/order_flags`.

EcommerceSettingsInput.description: The fields to change, grouped by section. `order_flags` cannot be written here.

ContinueShoppingSettings.description: The `continue_shopping` section: where the continue shopping link leads.

enable_continue_shopping.description: Turn continue shopping on or off.

continue_shopping_target.description: Where continue shopping leads: `home`, `previous` or `specified`. With `specified`, `continue_shopping_specified_target` names the page.

continue_shopping_specified_target.description: The slug of the page to link to. Required when `continue_shopping_target` is `specified`. `field_metadata` lists every page slug in your store under `options`, and a slug that names no page is rejected with `400 invalid_reference` and the message `not a known page slug`.

ProductInventorySettings.description: The `product_inventory` section: out-of-stock handling and when a sale reduces stock.

low_stock_notification.description: Get a low stock notification by email.

out_of_stock_notification.description: Get an out of stock notification by email.

hide_on_sale_tag_for_out_of_stock_produc.description: Do not display the "On Sale" tag on a sold out product.

order_quantity_over_stock.description: The stock rule when an order quantity is more than the stock: `add_available`, `sell_away`, `allow_admin_only_to_add_out_of_stock_products` or `do_not_sell`.

PricingSettings.description: The `pricing` section: minimum purchase amounts, on account purchase, credit limit and payment terms.

update_price_range.description: Adjust the price range for the product.

enable_minimum_purchase_amount.description: Turn on the minimum purchase amount.

minimum_purchase_amount.description: The minimum purchase amount. Depends on `enable_minimum_purchase_amount`, and is required and greater than `0` while it is on.

enable_minimum_purchase_amount_in_cart.description: Turn on the minimum purchase amount in cart details.

minimum_purchase_amount_in_cart.description: The minimum purchase amount in cart details. Depends on `enable_minimum_purchase_amount_in_cart`, and is required and greater than `0` while it is on.

assign_credit_limit_per_order.description: Set a credit limit for the account. Depends on `enable_on_account_purchase`.

credit_limit_per_order.description: The credit limit. Depends on `assign_credit_limit_per_order`, and is required while it is on. `0` is allowed and grants no credit. Can be `null`.

payment_terms.description: The net payment term: `NET_30`, `NET_60` or `NET_90`, written and returned as that string. Depends on `enable_payment_terms`. Can be `null`.

ProductRestrictionSettings.description: The `product_restriction` section: one switch for product restriction based on the parent category.

enable_product_restriction_based_on_pare.description: Allow product restriction based on the parent category.

OrderFilterSettings.description: The `order_filters` section: the status each admin order list opens on. A field is `null` when no default is set.

default_order_status.description: The default order status: `all`, `paused`, `in_progress`, `completed` or `reopened`, or `null` when unset.

default_payment_status.description: The default payment status: `all`, `paid`, `unpaid` or `partially_paid`, or `null` when unset.

default_shipment_status.description: The default shipment status: `all`, `unshipped`, `shipped`, `returned` or `partial`, or `null` when unset.

LocationSettings.description: The `location_settings` section. Only `enable_multi_location` can be written.

locations.description: A read-only list of your stock locations. Manage them through `/api/v4/admin/inventory_locations`. A body that sends `locations` is rejected with `400 invalid_request` and the message `no recognized ecommerce_settings fields in body`.

LocationSettingsInput.description: The `location_settings` fields you can write. `locations` is read-only.

EcommerceSettingsLocation.description: One stock location, as `location_settings.locations` lists it.

id.description: The stock location's `id`, which `/api/v4/admin/inventory_locations/{inventory_location_id}` takes as `inventory_location_id`.

created.description: When the location was created, such as `2026-07-16T06:24:24`.

updated.description: When the location was last changed.

EcommerceSettingsOrderFlag.description: One order flag, as `order_flags` lists it.

id.description: The order flag's `id`, which `/api/v4/admin/order_flags/{order_flag_id}` takes as `order_flag_id`.

color.description: The flag's colour as a hex code, such as `#FF6868`.

EcommerceSettingsGroupMeta.description: One entry per key under `ecommerce_settings`. Only [Get ecommerce settings](/api-reference/ecommerce-settings/get-ecommerce-settings) and [Update ecommerce settings](/api-reference/ecommerce-settings/update-ecommerce-settings) return it.

href.description: The key's own path, such as `/api/v4/admin/settings/ecommerce_settings/pricing`. For `order_flags` it is `/api/v4/admin/order_flags`.

locations_href.description: Only on `location_settings`: `/api/v4/admin/inventory_locations`, where you manage the stock locations.

EcommerceSettingsFieldMetadata.description: Describes each field with an `EcommerceSettingsFieldMetadataEntry`. On `/ecommerce_settings` it is keyed by section and then by field name; on a section it is keyed by field name.

type.description: The kind of value the field takes: `boolean`, `enum`, `decimal`, `reference` or `collection`.

default.description: The field's default value, when it has one.

nullable.description: `true` when the field can be empty.

depends_on.description: The field this one depends on, such as `enable_minimum_purchase_amount`.

description.description: A note about the field's values, on some fields, such as `Empty = unset.`

references.description: What a `reference` field points to: `page` for `continue_shopping_specified_target`.

options.description: For `continue_shopping_specified_target`, every page slug in your store.

code.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `invalid_request` or `not_found`.

details.description: One entry per rejected field. Empty when the error is not about a field.

code.description: Why it was rejected, such as `unknown_field` or `invalid_enum`.

value.description: The value you sent, when the API includes it.

PriceDisplayOrderItem.description: The `order_item` section: how each line item's own price shows.

price_including_tax.description: Show each line item's price with tax included.

price_including_discount.description: Show each line item's price with the discount included.

tax_in_line.description: Show the tax on each line item. Accepts the `shopping_cart` and `order_success` surfaces only.

discount_in_line_item.description: Show the discount on each line item.

item_total_including_tax.description: Show each line item's total with tax included. Accepts the `shopping_cart` and `order_success` surfaces only.

PriceDisplayOrderSummary.description: The `order_summary` section: the lines of the order summary and what each one includes.

order_total_excluding_tax.description: Show the order total with tax excluded.

order_total_including_discount.description: Show the order total with the discount included.

subtotal_tax.description: Show the subtotal tax line. One `enabled` value covers the shopping cart, checkout and the order success page.

total_tax.description: Show the total tax line. One `enabled` value covers checkout and the order success page.

order_total.description: Show the order total line. One `enabled` value covers the shopping cart, checkout and the order success page.

payment_surcharge.description: Show the payment surcharge in the order summary. Accepts the `checkout` and `order_success` surfaces only.

PriceDisplayScopes.description: The surfaces a setting applies to. A block accepts only the surfaces its `field_metadata` entry lists in `allowed_scopes`. A write that sends any other key is rejected with `400 invalid_request` and the reason `invalid_enum`.

PriceDisplayScopedToggle.description: A setting with a master switch and optional control per surface.

enabled.description: The master switch. While `customize` is `false`, every surface in `scopes` follows it.

customize.description: Set each surface in `scopes` yourself instead of following `enabled`.

scopes.description: The surfaces this setting applies to when `customize` is `true`.

PriceDisplayPlainToggle.description: A setting with only a master switch and no control per surface.

enabled.description: Turn the setting on or off.

PriceDisplaySubtotal.description: The subtotal line: where it shows, and whether it includes tax and discount.

show.description: Show the subtotal line on each surface.

include_tax.description: Show the subtotal with tax included.

include_discount.description: Show the subtotal with the discount included.

PriceDisplayDiscount.description: The discount line: where it shows, whether it hides when zero, and whether it includes tax.

show.description: Show the discount line on each surface.

hide_if_zero.description: Hide the discount line when the discount is zero.

include_tax.description: Show the discount with tax included.

PriceDisplayShippingCost.description: The shipping cost line: where it shows, and whether it includes tax and discount. Accepts the `checkout` and `order_success` surfaces only.

show.description: Show the shipping cost line on each surface.

include_tax.description: Show the shipping cost with tax included.

include_discount.description: Show the shipping cost with the discount included.

PriceDisplayShippingDiscount.description: The shipping discount line and the shipping tax line. Accepts the `checkout` and `order_success` surfaces only.

show.description: Show the shipping discount line on each surface.

include_tax.description: Show the shipping discount with tax included.

shipping_tax.description: Show the shipping tax line. One `enabled` value covers checkout and the order success page.

PriceDisplayHandling.description: The handling cost, shown apart from shipping, and its tax settings. Accepts the `checkout` and `order_success` surfaces only.

show_separately.description: Show the handling cost separately from shipping, on each surface.

include_tax.description: Show the handling cost with tax included.

handling_tax.description: Show the handling tax in the order summary.

PriceDisplayPricingInfo.description: A pricing information note shown after the total, and whether the order success page hides the due amount.

enabled.description: Show a custom pricing information note after the total.

text.description: The note's text. At most 2000 characters: a longer value is rejected with `400 invalid_request` and the reason `too_long`.

customize.description: Set the surfaces in `scopes` yourself instead of following `enabled`.

scopes.description: The surfaces the note shows on.

do_not_show_due_amount.description: Hide the due amount on the order success page.

PriceDisplayGroupMeta.description: One entry per section. Only [Get price display settings](/api-reference/price-display-settings/get-price-display-settings) and [Update price display settings](/api-reference/price-display-settings/update-price-display-settings) return it.

kind.description: What the section is. `setting` for both sections.

writable.description: Whether you can write to the section. `true` for both sections.

href.description: The section's own path, such as `/api/v4/admin/settings/price_display_settings/order_item`.

PriceDisplayFieldMetadata.description: Has the same nesting as the settings, with a `PriceDisplayFieldMetadataEntry` in place of each setting. A `scopes`, `show` or `show_separately` object gets one `scope_flags` entry. On `/price_display_settings` it is keyed by section; on a section path it holds that section under its own name.

type.description: The kind of value the field takes: `boolean`, `string` or `scope_flags`.

default.description: The field's default value, for a `boolean` or `string` field.

allowed_scopes.description: The surfaces the block accepts, for a `scope_flags` field.

scope_labels.description: A label for each surface in `allowed_scopes`.

max_length.description: The longest value accepted, for a `string` field. Only `order_summary.pricing_info.text` has it, set to `2000`.

code.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `invalid_request` or `not_found`.

details.description: One entry per rejected field. Empty when the error is not about a field.

code.description: Why it was rejected, such as `unknown_field` or `invalid_enum`.

value.description: The value you sent, when the API includes it.

ProductListingSettings.description: The product listing settings, in four sections.

ProductListingProductInformation.description: What each product shows on a listing tile.

show_summary.description: Show the product summary on each tile.

show_sale_percentage.description: Show the sale percentage on each tile.

show_stock_availability.description: Show the stock availability on each tile.

show_parent_category.description: Show the product's parent category on each tile.

show_loyalty_point.description: Show loyalty points on each tile.

show_variations_as_products.description: Show variations as separate products in the listing.

ProductListingInteractionButtons.description: The add to cart and view details buttons on each listing tile.

enabled.description: Show the buttons on each tile.

add_to_cart.description: Show the add to cart button.

ProductListingPrice.description: Which prices each listing tile shows.

enabled.description: Show the price.

expect_to_pay.description: Show the expect to pay price.

expect_to_pay_with_tax.description: Show the expect to pay price with tax.

ProductListingReviews.description: The rating stars on each listing tile and the review count beside them.

show_review_count.description: Show the review count beside the stars.

ProductListingVariationCombination.description: Which variation types each listing tile combines.

enabled.description: Show variation combinations on each tile.

types.description: Names of your store's variation types, such as `Color`. The entry for this field in `field_metadata` lists the names you can send under `allowed_values`. Any other name is rejected with `400` and `unknown variation type`.

ProductListingLoad.description: Whether a listing pages or loads more. `type` selects which block applies.

enabled.description: Turn the load settings on.

type.description: How the listing loads products: `pagination` uses the `pagination` block and `load_more` uses the `load_more` block. Any other value is rejected with `400`.

ProductListingLoadPagination.description: Where the pager shows and how many products a page holds.

position.description: Where the pager shows: `top`, `bottom` or `top_and_bottom`, or `null`. Any other value is rejected with `400`.

per_page.description: Products per page, from `1` to `999999`. `0` is rejected with `must be a positive integer for the selected load type`, and `1000000` with `must be between 1 and 999999`.

allow_user_per_page.description: Let shoppers change the number of products per page.

ProductListingLoadMore.description: How many products each press of load more adds.

per_load.description: Products added each time a shopper presses load more, from `1` to `999999`. While `load.type` is `pagination`, `0` is accepted.

ProductListingSorting.description: The order a listing is shown in.

enabled.description: Turn sorting on.

sort_by.description: The sort order: `alpha_asc`, `alpha_desc`, `price_desc`, `price_asc`, `created_asc` or `created_desc`, or `null`. Any other value is rejected with `400`.

ProductListingSortableItems.description: Whether a shopper can re-sort a listing, and by what.

enabled.description: Let shoppers re-sort the listing.

ProductListingSortableOptions.description: The sort orders a shopper can pick from.

ProductListingGroupMeta.description: One entry per section. No entry has an `href`, because no section has a path of its own.

kind.description: What the section is. `setting` for all four sections.

writable.description: Whether you can write to the section. `true` for all four sections.

ProductListingFieldMetadata.description: Keyed by section, then nested the same way as that section's settings, with a `ProductListingFieldMetadataEntry` in place of each field's value. Every field has an entry, and there are no other entries.

type.description: The kind of value the field takes, such as `enum_list` for `product_information.variation_combination.types`.

allowed_values.description: The values the field accepts. For `product_information.variation_combination.types`, the names of your store's variation types.

depends_on.description: Present on a field that depends on another field's value, such as `load.load_more.per_load`. A write to the field is still accepted when that other value does not switch it on.

ProductListingError.description: Describes why the request was rejected. The message gives the reason, such as `request body must be wrapped in a 'product_listing' object`.

id.description: The shipping method's id, assigned by the store. Pass it as `shipping_method_id` in a path.

is_default.description: `true` on the one default method. Only `PUT /admin/shipping_methods/{shipping_method_id}/default` changes it.

name.description: Required. At most 100 characters, and no other method may have the same name.

type.description: The field's value type: `integer` for `id`, `string` for `name` and `boolean` for `is_default`.

writable.description: Whether a write can set this field. `true` only for `name`.

required.description: Whether a write must send this field. Only `name` has it, set to `true`.

max_length.description: The longest value accepted. Only `name` has it, set to `100`.

ShippingMethodsFieldMetadata.description: Describes each field, keyed by field name. Returned only when you send `field_metadata=true`.

total.description: The number of shipping methods in the store.

limit.description: The page size the store applied. At most `20`.

offset.description: The number of rows skipped before this page.

count.description: The number of rows on this page.

current_page.description: The page that `offset` falls in, never more than `total_pages`.

previous_page.description: The previous page, or `null` on the first page.

next_page.description: The next page, or `null` on the last page. Check `has_next` before you request it.

code.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `invalid_request`, `not_found` or `conflict`.

details.description: Extra detail, or an empty list. On some errors the first entry's `code` gives the reason: `duplicate`, `default_in_use` or `unknown_parameter`.

id.description: The tax code's `id`, assigned by the store. Pass it as `tax_code_id` in a path. A create ignores any tax code `id` you send inside `tax_code`.

name.description: The tax code's name. Required when you create a tax code. An update that leaves it out keeps the stored name.

label.description: The tax code's label, or `null` when the tax code has none. An update that leaves it out keeps the stored label.

description.description: The tax code's description, or `null` when the tax code has none. An update that leaves it out keeps the stored description.

rate.description: The tax code's rate. An update that leaves it out keeps the stored rate.

resolver_type.description: The tax code's resolver type, such as `flat`. The store keeps any value you send without checking it. An update that leaves it out sets it to `flat`.

priority.description: The tax code's priority. An update that leaves it out sets it to `0`.

default.description: `true` marks a tax code the store built. More than one tax code can have it. Read-only: a create or an update that sends `default: true` stores `false`.

TaxCodeInput.description: The fields you can write. A create needs `name`; an update can leave it out.

name.description: Required when you create a tax code.

resolver_type.description: Stored exactly as you send it. An update that leaves it out sets it to `flat`.

priority.description: An update that leaves it out sets it to `0`.

total.description: The number of tax codes in the store.

limit.description: The page size the store applied. At most `20`.

offset.description: The number of tax codes skipped before this page.

count.description: The number of tax codes on this page.

previous_page.description: The URL of the previous page, or `null` on the first page.

next_page.description: The URL of the next page, or `null` on the last page.

TaxCodeError.description: What the store returns when it rejects a request.

errors.description: On a `400` `invalid_pagination`, names the rejected parameter: `limit` or `offset`.
